Title: Disney Intertwined Live
Writer: Mina Batista, Esteban Jaime Garrido, Agustín Lasso
Actors: Carolina Domenech, José Gimenez Zapiola, Tatu Glikman
Plot: A live show based on the Disney+ Original Series 'Intertwined,' featuring original songs, covers from the '90s and a selection of songs from 'Freaky Friday: A New Musical.'
